children: Clarivate announced pricing terms for its cash tender offer for 3.875% Senior Secured Notes due 2028, with total consideration of $975.15 per $1,000.
Clarivate's subsidiary offers to purchase 3.875% Senior Secured Notes due 2028, subject to a $75m tender cap.
Reference yield set at 4.864% and fixed spread of +50 bps, resulting in total consideration of $975.15 per $1,000.
Offer subject to proration if acceptances exceed the Tender Cap; company may adjust cap or accept up to +2% more.
Withdrawal deadline and expiration were 5:00 p.m. New York time on Sept 23, 2026; settlement expected Sept 25, 2026.
